brief.title: v0.2.6: every laptop's AI tools through one gateway
brief.why: v0.2.5 and v0.2.6 shipped since the last post (Laptops, IdP sign-in, the enforcement guide), so a release beats Friday's try-it rhythm. Yesterday was build-in-public with the docs scene; today is cards only.

cards.headline: Every laptop's AI calls, *through your gateway*
highlights: Claude Code, Claude Desktop and Codex rolled out by MDM

cards.headline: Signed in as a person. *Gated* as a key.

linkedin.text:
Half your engineers run Claude Code or Codex on their laptops. Which key are those calls made with, and who can see them?

Control Tower v0.2.6 is out. IT deploys the files from the Laptops page with Jamf, Intune or Kandji (Windows and Linux scripts too). The first time someone opens Claude Code, Claude Desktop or Codex, a small helper asks them to sign in. New today: that sign-in can go straight to Okta, Entra ID or any OpenID Connect provider.

From then on, every model call and MCP tool call goes through your gateway as a key chosen by team, with its budget and gates, recorded under the person's email. No shared key in the files, tokens last an hour, and signing out a computer applies at once.

We also wrote down where it stops. Managed settings keep these tools on the gateway; they don't stop someone calling a provider's API from their own code. The new enforcement guide covers all four layers: settings, sign-in, the network, and checking every computer.

Laptops is an Enterprise feature. The gateway is Apache-2.0 and runs in one docker command: https://github.com/joshmaster2165/controltower

A ⭐ helps others find it.

#AIAgents #PlatformEngineering #OpenSource

posts:
Control Tower v0.2.6: Claude Code, Claude Desktop and Codex on every laptop, sent through your gateway.

Rolled out by MDM. Each person signs in with Okta, Entra ID or any OIDC provider. Every model and MCP call is recorded under their email.

No shared key in the files you deploy. Tokens last an hour. A rule picks the key by team, so its budget and gates apply. Sign out a computer and it's out at once.

Lock down stops the tools reaching any other provider or MCP server.

Laptops is Enterprise. The gateway it runs on is Apache-2.0: one docker run, a live map of where your agents go.

A star helps others find it ⭐ https://github.com/joshmaster2165/controltower

brief.notes: Laptops and IdP sign-in are Enterprise (ELv2); the copy says so. All claims are from docs/changelog.md (0.2.5, 0.2.6), docs/laptops.md and docs/enforcement.md. No video today: the Laptops page needs a license, which the demo recorder may not have.
